name: 灯紀@Skeb募集中!
description: 灯紀(ひのり)と申します。雑多に絵をあげています。無断転載や自作発言、AI学習に私の絵を使用することはおやめ下さい。お別れはブロ解にてお願いしますね！pixiv→https://www.pixiv.net/users/72091353

works.body: Character: Hakurei Reimu Clothes: normal shrine maiden clothes Content: I want to see Reimu put her feet in a pool with a lot of small fish to experience fish pedicure. It is very, very, very ticklish so I think Reimu needs to try really hard to keep not laughing. We could see a cute blush and a look of restraint on her face. I really love seeing handsome Reimu's face turning red. Her shoes (black miko geta) without socks (I think she wears this with barefeet) are push near her legs. And please draw a close-up of her foot in the left-top or right-top of the image. Small fish are attacking her soles and her foot is curling up.  You can take this as reference:  https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/85512863
